tui_engine_deps_could_not_run: Why the dependency install or pre_command could not even start. {error} is the operating system's own text.
tui_engine_deps_exit: Why the dependency install or pre_command failed: its exit code and its last output line.
tui_engine_deps_killed: Why the dependency install or pre_command failed when it was ended by a signal (no exit code); {tail} is its last output line.
tui_engine_deps_not_found: The dependency install or pre_command failed because its program was not found: the binary (or a note that it could not be named), the PATH Atlas ran with and how to fix it (per operating system). {bin} is a program name, {path} a PATH.
tui_engine_docker_compose_failed: Why docker compose up failed. {exit} is the exit code or a signal note, {detail} the first words docker printed, or a note that there was no output.
tui_engine_docker_compose_missing: Docker advice shown when the compose plugin is missing.

tui_engine_docker_daemon_down.description: Docker advice shown when the daemon is not running. Names the way to start it on Linux and on macOS.

tui_engine_docker_exit_code: Part of a docker failure: the exit code of the command. Fills {exit} of the compose failure.
tui_engine_docker_exit_signal: Part of a docker failure: the command was ended by a signal. Fills {exit} of the compose failure.
tui_engine_docker_no_output: Part of a docker failure: the command printed nothing. Fills {detail} of the compose failure.
tui_engine_docker_not_found: Why docker could not be started: the program was not found. {path} is the PATH that was searched.
tui_engine_docker_permission: Docker advice shown when the user may not use the docker socket: how to join the docker group and log out and in again. i18n-allow dnt:log
tui_engine_docker_permission_run: Why docker could not be started: the operating system refused. {error} is its own text.
tui_engine_docker_recovered: Alert text when the Docker daemon answers again.
tui_engine_docker_run_failed: Why docker could not be started. {error} is the operating system's own text.
tui_engine_docker_unreachable: Alert text when the Docker daemon stops answering.
tui_engine_health_hang: Alert and event-log text when a service stopped answering its liveness probe. {misses} is the misses in a row, {timeout} the seconds one probe waits.
tui_engine_health_hang_restarting: Same as the liveness alert, for a service Atlas restarts because on_unhealthy is restart.
tui_engine_health_hang_spent: Event-log text when a hung service keeps hanging after the restarts its budget allows, so Atlas leaves it running.
tui_engine_health_unhealthy_for: Sidebar note of a service that stopped answering: how long and how many probes it missed.
tui_engine_infra_port_closed: Why an infra service (a container) is failed: its port never opened. {port} and {secs} are the port and the seconds Atlas waited.
tui_engine_memory_back_under: Event-log text when a service falls back under its memory_warn budget.
tui_engine_memory_leak_reloads: Alert and sidebar text for a suspected memory leak across reloads. {growth} is a size, {cycles} the reloads seen.
tui_engine_memory_leak_restarts: Alert and sidebar text for a suspected memory leak across restarts. {growth} is a size, {cycles} the restarts seen.
tui_engine_memory_notify: Alert text for a service over max_memory that Atlas only reports because on_memory_max is notify. {used} and {max} are sizes.
tui_engine_memory_over_max: Why a service is degraded: it is over its max_memory budget. {used} and {max} are sizes.
tui_engine_memory_over_warn: Why a service is degraded: it is over its memory_warn budget. {used} and {warn} are sizes.
tui_engine_memory_restarting: Alert text for a service over max_memory that Atlas restarts. {attempt} of {limit} restarts used.
tui_engine_memory_stopped: Alert text for a service over max_memory after the restarts its budget allows: Atlas stops it.
tui_engine_note_lines: Two engine sentences one above the other (a docker hint over the failure it explains).
tui_engine_note_pair: Two engine sentences on one line, joined by a middle dot (a wait and who holds the port; a reason and a suspected leak).
tui_engine_port_held: Why a service cannot start: another process holds its port. {stop} is the shell command that ends it, {cmd} the process name.
tui_engine_port_held_cwd: Same as the port-held text, when the holder's working directory is known: {cwd}.
tui_engine_probe_ready_failed: Why a service is degraded: its ready probe failed. {error} is the probe's own error text.
tui_engine_probe_repeating: Why a service is degraded: the same error keeps appearing in its output. {line} is a sample line, as printed.
tui_engine_sched_completed: Event-log text when a one-shot service finished successfully.
tui_engine_sched_crashed_restart: Event-log text when a service crashed and Atlas will restart it. {attempt} of {limit} (limit is a number or the infinity sign).
tui_engine_sched_dependency_failed: Why a service is failed: a service it depends on failed, so it never started.

tui_engine_sched_done.description: Sidebar note of a service that finished on purpose.
tui_engine_sched_done.distinct: a lowercase note on a finished service in the sidebar, not the Done button

tui_engine_sched_exited: Why a service is failed: its process exited with code 0 and the service is not a one-shot.
tui_engine_sched_exited_cleanly: Event-log text when a service exited with code 0 and no restart follows.
tui_engine_sched_exited_error: Why a service is failed: its process exited with an error.
tui_engine_sched_exited_restart: Event-log text when a service exited and Atlas will restart it. {attempt} of {limit} (limit is a number or the infinity sign).
tui_engine_sched_gave_up: Why a service is failed: its restart budget is spent. {attempts} restarts were tried. English keeps the same words for one and many on purpose, the sentence has always read that way.
tui_engine_sched_restarted: Sidebar note of a running service that was restarted {attempts} times in this streak.
tui_engine_sched_restarting: Event-log text when a scheduled restart fires.
tui_engine_sched_restarting_in: Sidebar note of a service waiting to be restarted. {attempt} of {limit} (limit is a number or the infinity sign).
tui_engine_sched_stable: Event-log text when a service ran long enough to reset its restart counter.
tui_engine_sched_start_timeout_log: Sidebar note of a service that waited too long for its ready_log line.
tui_engine_sched_start_timeout_port: Sidebar note of a service that waited too long for its port to open.
tui_engine_sched_still_starting_log: Alert and event-log text when a service has been starting longer than its start_timeout and waits for its ready_log line.
tui_engine_sched_still_starting_port: Alert and event-log text when a service has been starting longer than its start_timeout and waits for its port.
tui_engine_sched_waiting_dep: Event-log and sidebar text of a service held back by a dependency. {condition} is the depends_on condition as written in atlas.yaml.
tui_engine_sched_waiting_log: Sidebar note of a starting service that waits for its ready_log line.
tui_engine_sched_waiting_port: Sidebar note of a starting service that waits for its port to open.
tui_engine_spawn_empty_command: Why a service is failed: its command is empty.
tui_engine_spawn_failed: Why a service is failed: the process could not be created. {command} and {dir} are the command and its directory, {error} the operating system's text.
tui_engine_tunnel_failed: Alert text when the SSH tunnel cannot connect. {host} is the ssh host, {reason} the engine's own explanation.
